programs.name: soft_closed_neighborhood
programs.rationale: Uses a smooth count penalty that returns direct reward for isolates and approaches reward per conflict for large neighborhoods. Reach is local degree; scalar arithmetic is cheap, while active degree maintenance remains charged and blocker weights are ignored.

programs.name: effective_blocker_blend
programs.rationale: Blends blocker count with conflict mass measured in units of the larger root or rival weight. Reach is the immediate weighted neighborhood; fixed arithmetic adds no traversal, but summary maintenance remains charged and neighbor compatibility is unknown.

programs.name: dominance_and_pressure
programs.rationale: Softens the count penalty when root reward covers all blocker mass; otherwise uses the larger count or reward-relative mass pressure. Reach is one neighborhood, with fixed conditional arithmetic; aggregate maintenance remains charged and contested neighborhoods lack topology information.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + 0.5 * degree) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / (1 + max(degree, conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

programs.name: bounded_density_discount
programs.rationale: Modestly softens count pressure when the root blocks a large fraction of the active set, retaining a positive denominator throughout. Reach combines local degree and residual size; arithmetic is fixed, but active count updates remain charged and density does not reveal neighbor connectivity.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + degree * (1 - 0.25 * min(1, degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1))))

programs.name: residual_mean_contrast
programs.rationale: Adjusts count efficiency by a bounded comparison between mean preserved weight and mean blocker weight, keeping counts and weights separately normalized. Reach includes coarse residual totals; repeated scalar arithmetic and aggregate maintenance cost time, and preserved contacts may conflict with each other.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.15 * (compatible_weight / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1) - conflict_weight / max(1, degree)) / (1 + compatible_weight / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1) + conflict_weight / max(1, degree)))

programs.name: bounded_rival_adjustment
programs.rationale: Applies a bounded strongest-rival margin correction to reward per blocked count, preserving reward units and positive scores. Reach is local degree and maximum rival weight; arithmetic is fixed, while summary refresh remains charged and several feasible rivals can defeat the exchange proxy.

programs.name: reward_with_soft_occupancy
programs.rationale: Retains reward scale with a modest bounded penalty for resource gap overhead relative to contact duration. Reach is root-only with few scalar operations; common-kernel work still applies, and the occupancy proxy ignores graph displacement.
programs.rule: weight * (1 - 0.15 * max(station_gap, satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap)))

programs.name: capped_capture_envelope
programs.rationale: Takes the larger count-efficiency or weighted-capture estimate, capped at twenty percent above count efficiency. Reach is local count and conflict mass; min/max arithmetic is fixed and summary maintenance remains charged, while optimistic capture can overvalue overlapping alternatives.
programs.rule: min(1.2 * weight / (1 + degree), max(weight / (1 + degree), weight * (weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))))
